judgments.reason: Dataset's "Published in" cites this paper; same authors (Zilber, Ciuciu, Gramfort, Azizi, van Wassenhove) and the hMT+ localizer MEG data come from the vision-only training group in this study.
judgments.paper_title: Supramodal processing optimizes visual perceptual learning and plasticity

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool used to convert this dataset to BIDS format; it does not describe this hMT+ localizer MEG dataset itself.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: MEG-BIDS is the standard specification the dataset was formatted with (Niso et al. 2018), not a paper describing this hMT+ localizer dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MEG-BIDS, the brain imaging data structure extended to magnetoencephalography
